With its striking design and high-quality materials, this shoe is more than just a sneaker - it celebrates your club pride and adidas craftsmanship. Make a statement with a pair that combines sport and style.

products.title: Norda 005
products.body_html: The 005 is the lightest, fastest, most stable super shoe ever crafted for trail runners. Engineered for race day(s). Rather than simply take technological conventions from road running and apply them to trail, we have developed a highly responsive and stable shoe with super critical foam that caters to the specific demands of race day performance on trail.

products.body_html: The casual BIRKENSTOCK Reykjavik is built to last. products.title: Nike Kobe III Low Protro
products.body_html: This Kobe III Low Protro is made of breathable materials and features a padded tongue for superior comfort. The full-length Air Zoom Strobel and Cushion 3.0 foam enhance the responsiveness and energy efficiency of the original model. And the redesigned traction system reduces weight for a faster, lighter feel on the court.

products.title: Nike Vomero 18
products.body_html: The Vomero offers comfort for daily runs with maximum cushioning. In this shoe, lightweight ZoomX foam on top of responsive ReactX foam in the midsole delivers the softest and most cushioned running experience Nike has to offer. The redesigned traction pattern allows for a smooth roll from heel to toe.

products.title: Nike JA 4 'Nightmare'
products.body_html: Jas's bounce puts the defense on the defensive, and the JA 4 creates unstoppable nightmares. The responsive Cushlon 3.0 foam delivers explosive bounce and cushions every landing. The sleek support system, combined with the supportive upper, ensures a secure fit so you're always ready to send any defender running.

products.title: Nike Moon Shoe OG
products.body_html: Before Nike was even called Nike, Bill Bowerman created the company's first running shoe using his wife's waffle iron. This modern take brings the original design back into the limelight. The nylon upper, complete with a leather Swoosh, pairs with a waffle sole to recreate the 1970s running shoe style. Step through history with the shoe that started it all.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 Retro Low (GS)
products.body_html: MJ won his first championship in these shoes. Okay—not exactly in this pair of AJ6s. His high-top was made in 1991, but this low-top version has all the other features that make the AJ6 an icon: a visible Nike Air element in the sole, a perforated upper, and lace locks (so you only have to tie your shoes once).

products.title: Nike Shox NZ Posite
products.body_html:
The Nike Shox NZ is a reimagined version of the classic from the early 2000s and recreates the original with a synthetic leather upper. The Nike Shox cushioning underfoot ensures optimal comfort and a performance-inspired look.

The synthetic leather upper is durable and comfortable.
Nike Shox columns provide responsive cushioning that was originally developed for runners.
The low-cut, padded collar looks sleek and feels great.

products.title: Nike WMNS First Sight Noir
products.body_html: Introducing Nike Noir—the first design from First Sight, a collection that takes athletic style to new heights. The Noir draws on Nike’s DNA and blends athleticism with bold style. The sleek, one-piece upper, the circular heel cutout, and the thick, angular midsole strike a balance between sophistication and raw speed. The result is a shoe made for those who are always one step ahead.

products.title: Nike WMNS Air Max Dolce
products.body_html: From the running track to the red carpet—the Air Max Dolce has led an exciting life. Now it’s back and ready for whatever the future holds. The details that make the Dolce an icon of the Air Max family remain unchanged—from the laceless, contoured upper with its overlay cage to the visible Air element in the heel that gives the shoe its unmistakable shape. Whether you wear it as a casual slip-on or as an elegant companion for special occasions is entirely up to you.

products.title: adidas Originals WMNS SUPERSTAR LO PRO
products.body_html:

For everyday wear, this shoe combines comfort and confidence with a touch of rebellion. The textile lining ensures a soft feel and keeps your feet comfortable all day long.

products.title: adidas Originals HANDBALL SPEZIAL
products.body_html:
Bring the tradition of the Handball Spezial shoe back to life. This true icon from adidas Originals was originally designed in 1979 for elite handball players and has since become a must-have for anyone who appreciates timeless design and everyday comfort.
The vintage-inspired silhouette is complemented by a soft natural rubber outsole that stays true to its roots while offering reliable traction on city streets. The lacing system ensures a secure fit and comfortable wear.
The CORDURA Ripstop upper and suede overlays give the shoe durability and structure, while contrast stitching and a smooth inner lining provide a sophisticated, high-quality finish.

products.title: adidas Originals HANDBALL SPEZIAL WTR
products.body_html:
Introducing the Handball Spezial WTR shoe—a reimagined version of an adidas icon, designed for the challenges of winter. It combines street style with practical features and is a must-have for everyday wear during the cold season.
This shoe features a durable upper made of high-quality leather panels and a water-repellent textile section at the heel, making it built to last. The Aditex insole guarantees extra warmth and comfort even as temperatures drop, while the mudguard keeps your feet dry.

Air Jordan x J Balvin 4 Retro 'Lemonade'
products.body_html: Jordan Brand and J Balvin are continuing their collaboration on MJ’s signature collection. After the two trendsetters have already co-designed the AJ1, AJ2, and AJ3, the highly coveted AJ4 is next. For this release, the “Prince of Reggaeton” draws inspiration from his roots in Medellín, Colombia. For luxurious comfort, the shoe combines a padded collar and a padded tongue with visible Nike Air cushioning and a high-quality full-grain leather upper featuring a crocodile-textured finish. The unique details lend the popular design a touch of elegance. High-quality, bilingual “Just Do It.” elements on the laces and the signature Jumpman and J Balvin co-branding symbolize their long-standing collaboration.

products.title: Air Jordan 14 Retro Mule 'Mowalola '
products.body_html: The Mowalola is a bold reinterpretation of the classic AJ14 as an elegant and comfortable mule that combines a classic loafer upper, Air Zoom cushioning, and traditional Jordan style. The tooth-like cutouts on the midsole remain, while the embroidered lettering adds an elegant touch to the shoe.

products.title: adidas Originals x Bad Bunny BadBo 1.0
products.body_html:
Embrace the future with the BADBO 1.0—a tribute to the Puerto Rican spirit and creativity. Inspired by the adidas archive, this model blends influences from aerobics, skateboarding, and basketball, capturing the energy of Bad Bunny’s roots and rise to fame.
Designed for anyone who dares to stand out, this shoe celebrates resilience and cultural pride, turning every step into a statement. With a rubber outsole for reliable grip, it provides a secure, comfortable fit.
The leather and textile upper creates a premium look, while the regular fit offers everyday comfort. adidas combines traditional heritage with modern innovation, creating a shoe that honors the past while looking optimistically toward the future.
Whether you’re exploring the city or simply expressing your style—this shoe is made for anyone who values individuality and bold design. Make a statement with adidas and Bad Bunny’s vision for a new iconic shoe.

The mesh upper is encased in a striking RPU cage inspired by the F50 Spider. The tongue and collar are padded for added comfort, and the 3-Stripes provide the unmistakable adidas identity.
adidas combines soccer innovation, classic design elements, and fresh style in a city shoe that offers grip, comfort, and an eye-catching look.
